context.architecture: Client-heavy PWA, no SSR/ISR, no Middleware, CSP-only serverless route

goals: Keep usage comfortably below Hobby limits (<=60% for first two months).
Prevent regressions in artifact size and runtime bundles.
Maintain offline reliability and session safety.
Control AI costs while preserving UX quality.
Document and automate routine checks (no background servers).

automations.title: Weekly Vercel Usage Check
automations.prompt: Search for Vercel usage metrics and summarize Fast Data Transfer, Edge Requests, Functions (invocations, memory-hrs, Active CPU). Notify if any exceed 60% or 80%.

automations.title: Per-PR Bundle Budget Gate
automations.prompt: Tell me if initial JS, total JS, or fonts exceed budgets; list top 10 offenders and suggested lazy-load points.

automations.title: Monthly Artifact Audit
automations.prompt: Search last production build logs for artifact size and serverless bundle sizes; compare month-over-month drift and flag >10% growth.

automations.title: PWA Offline Health Self-Test
automations.prompt: Tell me to run an offline smoke test: install SW, precache, toggle offline, verify dashboard/timer, check outbox replay.

automations.title: SW Cache Pressure Test & Eviction
automations.prompt: Tell me to simulate cache growth to cap per tier and verify eviction policies; report retained counts per tier.

automations.title: AI Cost & Usage Guardrail
automations.prompt: Tell me daily prompt counts per device; if >N/day (configurable), show a banner enabling low-cost mode; apply exponential backoff and circuit breaker on repeated failures.

automations.title: Backup Reminder (Local Export)
automations.prompt: Tell me to prompt the user to export a local backup (JSON) with integrity checksum and store safely.

automations.title: Security Header & CSP Audit
automations.prompt: Tell me to verify CSP report volume, check for unsafe-inline/hash exceptions, and ensure headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy) are intact.

automations.title: Dependency Hygiene
automations.prompt: Tell me to review dependency updates, remove unused deps, and check for large transitive packages inflating bundles.

automations.title: Privacy & Terms Review
automations.prompt: Tell me to re-validate that policies match current behavior (no cookies/analytics; local-first; AI usage noted).

runbooks.title: Deploy/Promote Runbook
steps: Verify preview build metrics: build time, artifact size, serverless sizes.
Promote to production; run PWA smoke test; log metrics.
rollback: Use Vercel Rollback to previous production.
Open incident note and capture timeline.

runbooks.title: Service Worker Update Prompt Runbook
steps: Detect waiting SW; show 'Update available' banner.
If active timer: defer activation until session end; else allow immediate refresh.
BroadcastChannel: notify all tabs to refresh.

runbooks.title: AI Circuit Breaker Runbook
steps: Track prompt errors; on N consecutive failures, open circuit for configured window.
Show low-cost-mode banner; fall back to cached summaries.

success_criteria: Two consecutive months with all Hobby metrics under 60%.
Zero incidents of mid-session disruption due to SW updates.
